rules.TEAM_TOTAL_RUNS: Requires authoritative full innings completion (20 overs / all out / official match final). Cannot settle on partial/stale in-play overs.
rules.DISMISSAL_SCORE: Can settle once the specific dismissal snapshot (e.g. 5th wicket) is recorded in match_dismissal_snapshots. If innings concludes with fewer wickets, market voids.
rules.WICKET_IN_OVER: Can settle once the target over snapshot is recorded in match_over_snapshots with verified wicket count (score delta).
rules.OVER_TOTAL_RUNS: Can settle once the target over snapshot is recorded in match_over_snapshots with verified runs delta.
rules.MATCH_WINNER: Requires authoritative event finality and grace window expiration. Stale feed or vanished fixture strictly blocks settlement.
